fields.process: Grower contract to product on the shelf
fields.scope: Starts when a grower contract is committed, ends when the product is on the retailer's shelf inside its shelf life

nodes.title: Grower contracts and crop plan
nodes.detail: Agronomists commit volumes with growers ahead of the season

nodes.title: Raw intake and quality check
nodes.detail: Loads are inspected, sampled and booked in

nodes.title: Production and batching
nodes.detail: Chilled lines convert raw produce into finished batches

nodes.title: Cold storage and shelf-life allocation
nodes.detail: Pallets are stored and allocated by remaining shelf life

nodes.title: Retailer order and allocation
nodes.detail: EDI orders are received and allocated against stock

nodes.title: Distribution to stores
nodes.detail: Chilled vehicles run store drops overnight

nodes.title: LIMS and QA records
nodes.detail: Lab results and supplier certificates of analysis, mostly scanned PDFs

nodes.title: MES batch records
nodes.detail: Line, batch and pallet genealogy; held separately from the ERP

nodes.title: ERP with retailer EDI
nodes.detail: Orders, allocations and invoices across six chains

nodes.title: Cold-chain IoT loggers
nodes.detail: Per-trailer temperature traces, downloaded on return rather than streamed

nodes.title: Quality paperwork is keyed by hand
nodes.detail: 25 min per load re-keying certificate and spec data out of supplier PDFs

nodes.title: Recall traceability takes days
nodes.detail: Tracing a batch across intake, line and pallet takes 2-3 days; the regulator expects 4 hours

nodes.title: Promotion weeks break the forecast
nodes.detail: 28% forecast error on promotion weeks; 3.4% of product written off

nodes.title: Cold-chain breaches found at the store
nodes.detail: Temperature excursions surface on arrival, not in transit; ~90 incidents a year

nodes.title: Certificate and spec extraction
nodes.detail: Reads the supplier document and pre-fills the intake record for the technician to confirm

nodes.title: Recall trace assistant
nodes.detail: Answers a batch trace across intake, line and pallet records in minutes

nodes.title: Short-horizon demand forecast
nodes.detail: Forecasts daily demand with weather and promotion signals so allocation stops guessing

nodes.title: In-transit excursion prediction
nodes.detail: Predicts a temperature breach while the vehicle can still be diverted

nodes.title: Shelf life is the hard constraint
nodes.detail: A forecast that lifts availability but adds a day of stock destroys margin - score against waste, not fill rate

nodes.title: Loggers are downloaded, not streamed
nodes.detail: In-transit prediction needs a live feed first; that is an infrastructure decision before it is a model one
